44 NN ;; Heading.
46 MX [x.ha-idempotency-key,run016.ha-no-false-idempotency] ;; The Idempotency-Key convention is added; claiming idempotency only when implemented is RUN-016.
48 MX [api006.ha-conditional,x.http-428] ;; Standard conditional requests (ETag/If-Match/412) instead of custom codes is API-006; 428 for an absent required precondition is the added 428 rule.

61 OL [api002.ha-stable-codes]
63 NN ;; Heading.
65-87 DU ;; Decision table restating the semantics above.

C x.consistent-status EX API-003 MUST ;; Keep status behaviour consistent across similar endpoints (e.g. one convention for repeated DELETE of an absent resource: 204 or 404). ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C api003.ha-200 OL API-003 DEFAULT ;; 200 for successful GET, PUT/PATCH returning the representation, operation POSTs without a created resource and queries returning data. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api004.ha-empty OL API-004 DEFAULT ;; An empty collection is 200 with [], clearer than 204. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api003.ha-201 OL API-003 MUST ;; 201 when the HTTP operation created a new API resource; PUT may return 201 when it creates the target. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.201-location EX API-003 DEFAULT ;; Include Location (CreatedAtAction) when a stable URI exists. ;; = ;; Stable URI exists. ;; Not in the oracle.
C api003.ha-202 OL API-003 MUST ;; 202 when processing is accepted but incomplete (long-running, background, queued work). ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.202-operation EX API-003 DEFAULT ;; Return an operation id or Location where 202 progress is observable. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C api003.ha-204 OL API-003 MUST ;; 204 for success with no body; a 204 never carries a body. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.http-304 EX API-003 MUST ;; 304 only for conditional requests with a still-valid cached representation; never a generic 'nothing changed' business response. ;; = ;; none ;; EXC-009 context.
C api005.ha-400 OL API-005,API-010 MUST ;; 400 when the request itself is invalid (malformed JSON, shape, binding, formatting, missing transport input); never for authentication failure. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api005.ha-401-403 OL API-005 MUST ;; 401 when authentication is missing or failed; 403 when authenticated but not permitted (not fixable by resending credentials). ;; = ;; none ;;
C api004.ha-404 OL API-004,API-005 MUST ;; 404 when the resource does not exist or the API deliberately hides it. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.http-406-415 EX API-003 MUST ;; 406 when no acceptable representation can be produced; 415 for unsupported request body formats. ;; = ;; none ;; EXC-009 context.
C api006.ha-409 OL API-006 MUST ;; 409 for valid requests conflicting with current state (uniqueness, transitions, concurrent operations, reused idempotency keys); not for malformed syntax. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api006.ha-412 OL API-006 MUST ;; 412 when a supplied precondition is false. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.http-422 EX API-003 DEFAULT ;; 422 for structurally valid but semantically invalid requests; follow an established 400-for-both convention; new distinguishing APIs use 400 for contract errors and 422 for semantics. ;; = ;; Established convention. ;; Not in the oracle.
C x.http-428 EX API-006 MUST ;; 428 when the contract requires a precondition the client omitted (missing If-Match → 428; stale → 412). ;; = ;; none ;; Not in API-006.
C x.http-429 EX API-003 MUST ;; 429 for rate-limited requests with Retry-After when known; never for validation failures. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C api007.ha-500 OL API-007,API-002 MUST ;; 500 for unexpected internal failures, via centralized handling and ProblemDetails. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.http-502-504 EX API-003 MUST_NOT ;; 502/504 only when acting as an intermediary (invalid upstream response / upstream timeout); do not map every dependency failure to 502. ;; = ;; none ;; EXC-009 context.
C x.http-503 EX API-003 DEFAULT ;; 503 for temporary inability (maintenance, critical dependency unavailable, overload) with Retry-After when meaningful. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C api021.ha-distinguish OL API-021,RUN-019 MUST ;; Distinguish client cancellation, own timeout and upstream timeout; not every TaskCanceledException is a 504. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.ha-idempotency-key EX RUN-016 DEFAULT ;; For a POST that must not duplicate effects consider an Idempotency-Key stored with request/result per the contract. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C run016.ha-no-false-idempotency OL RUN-016 MUST_NOT ;; Claim idempotency only when it is implemented. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api006.ha-conditional OL API-006 MUST ;; Use standard conditional requests (ETag, If-Match → 412) for HTTP optimistic concurrency, not custom status codes. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api002.ha-stable-codes OL API-002,FE-009 MUST ;; Machine-readable clients rely on stable error codes or contract fields, never human-readable messages. ;; = ;; none ;;

88 MX [run005.hcf-anti-list,x.hcf-client-styles,x.hcf-headers,x.hcf-no-status-passthrough] ;; Anti-patterns restating RUN-005/RUN-016/RUN-017/ARC-025/RUN-003/GOV-013; a mandated single client model, dynamic tokens in shared headers and uniform upstream status mapping restate the added rules.

C arc025.hcf-shape OL ARC-025,ARC-007 MUST ;; The use-case layer defines the outbound abstraction and the implementation layer implements it; the use case need not know the remote service speaks HTTP. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.hcf-client-styles EX RUN-005 DEFAULT ;; Named, typed and keyed clients are all valid; choose the simplest for consumer and lifetime; keyed only when keyed DI is clearer; no single mandatory model. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C arc022.hcf-typed-singleton OL ARC-022 MUST_NOT ;; Do not capture a transient typed client inside a singleton without understanding the lifetime consequences. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.hcf-handlers EX ARC-025 MUST_NOT ;; DelegatingHandler only for genuine pipeline concerns (tokens, correlation, signing), never business decisions. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C run003.hcf-pass-token OL RUN-003,RUN-019 MUST ;; Pass the caller's token; CancellationToken.None only when the operation intentionally outlives the request. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run015.hcf-timeouts OL RUN-015 MUST ;; Choose timeouts from the remote operation and latency budget; distinguish per-attempt from total timeouts with resilience pipelines. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc025.hcf-translate OL ARC-025 MUST ;; Translate remote responses into the abstraction's outcomes. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.hcf-no-blind-ensure EX ARC-025 MUST_NOT ;; Do not call EnsureSuccessStatusCode() blindly when specific statuses carry meaning. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C x.hcf-no-status-passthrough EX API-003,ARC-025 MUST_NOT ;; Do not forward every upstream status to the own API or map every upstream failure to one status; outbound retry and inbound response are separate decisions. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C run016.hcf-retry-safety OL RUN-016 MUST ;; Before enabling retry decide transience, repeat safety, remote idempotency and duplicate risk; PUT/DELETE are not operationally safe merely by HTTP definition; POST/PATCH need idempotency keys, natural idempotency or deduplication. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.hcf-headers EX RUN-005 MUST_NOT ;; Stable headers on the client, per-request values per request or via a handler; never mutate shared DefaultRequestHeaders concurrently. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C x.hcf-json-contracts EX ARC-025,ARC-002 MUST_NOT ;; Prefer System.Net.Http.Json/System.Text.Json with explicit options when contracts differ; do not reuse domain entities as remote contracts. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C x.hcf-adapter-tests EX TST-003 DEFAULT ;; Test adapters with a controlled HttpMessageHandler (method/path, headers, payload, mapping, cancellation/failure). ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C run005.hcf-tests-ok OL RUN-005 ALLOWED ;; Constructing HttpClient directly in a focused test is fine; the lifetime rule concerns production code. ;; = ;; Tests only. ;;
C run005.hcf-anti-list OL RUN-005,RUN-016,RUN-017,ARC-025,RUN-003,GOV-013 AVOID ;; Avoid per-request HttpClient, unsafe retries without idempotency analysis, unbounded retries, leaking HttpResponseMessage, ignored cancellation and resilience pipelines without understanding. ;; = ;; none ;;

19 MX [run016.res-retry-safety,x.res-retry-categories,x.res-no-invented-key] ;; Retrying only transient, duplicate-safe failures is RUN-016; the explicit category lists and not inventing an unsupported Idempotency-Key are added.
20 OL [run017.res-retry-after]
21 EX [x.res-circuit-breaker]

23 OL [run016.res-hedging]

30 NN ;; Heading.
32 EX [x.res-messaging]
34 NN ;; Heading.
36 MX [x.res-observe,gov013.res-no-otel] ;; Observing retries/timeouts/circuits where operationally important is added; resilience not requiring OpenTelemetry restates GOV-013/DEP-002.
38 NN ;; Heading.
40-50 DU ;; Decision table restating the guidance above.

C dep020.res-mex-apis OL DEP-020 DEFAULT ;; Microsoft resilience packages by default (direct Polly only as documented exception); application code configures them through the Microsoft.Extensions resilience APIs. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run016.res-standard-handler OL RUN-016 MUST ;; The standard handler helps when its behaviour fits; it is not mandatory and its retry behaviour needs review for state-changing requests. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run015.res-no-overlap OL RUN-015 AVOID ;; Avoid stacking handlers with overlapping strategies. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run015.res-attempt-total OL RUN-015 MUST ;; Set attempt and total-operation timeouts. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run016.res-retry-safety OL RUN-016 MUST_NOT ;; Retry only plausibly transient failures; never non-idempotent operations without duplicate prevention; ask what a resend does after a lost response. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.res-retry-categories EX RUN-016 MUST_NOT ;; Transient: selected network failures, temporary unavailability, rate limiting when allowed, transient provider database failures; never validation, auth failures, permanent 404 or deterministic business rejection. ;; = ;; none ;; Explicit categories beyond RUN-016.
C x.res-no-invented-key EX RUN-016 MUST_NOT ;; Do not invent a client-side Idempotency-Key unless the remote service supports it. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in RUN-016.
C run017.res-retry-after OL RUN-017 DEFAULT ;; Prefer the server's Retry-After guidance over an independent aggressive schedule. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.res-circuit-breaker EX RUN-015 DEFAULT ;; Circuit breakers when repeated calls to a failing dependency add load/latency, with production visibility; skip without a repeated-failure scenario. ;; = ;; none ;; EXC-007 context.
C run016.res-hedging OL RUN-016 MUST_NOT ;; Hedge only operations safe to run several times (typically idempotent reads); never writes by default. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.res-inbound-429 EX API-003 DEFAULT ;; Inbound rate limiting is separate from outbound resilience; rejected requests get 429 with Retry-After when useful. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C x.res-db-resilience EX RUN-016 MUST_NOT ;; Do not wrap normal ORM operations in a generic application retry pipeline; prefer the provider execution strategy; HTTP retry policies are not database policies. ;; = ;; none ;; EXC-007 context.
C x.res-messaging EX RUN-016 DEFAULT ;; Publication retries can duplicate delivery; use idempotent consumers, deduplication or an outbox when needed; never claim exactly-once because a retry exists. ;; = ;; When needed. ;; Not in the oracle.
C x.res-observe EX - DEFAULT ;; Observe retry counts, timeouts, circuit state, rate-limit rejections and dependency latency where operationally important, with the adopted telemetry stack. ;; = ;; Where operationally important. ;; Not in the oracle.
C gov013.res-no-otel OL GOV-013,DEP-002 MUST_NOT ;; Resilience alone does not require OpenTelemetry. ;; = ;; none ;;

C x.log-levels EX RUN-013 DEFAULT ;; Levels by operational meaning: Trace/Debug diagnostics, Information for meaningful events (not every call), Warning for recovered/degraded states, Error for failures needing attention, Critical when the application cannot continue. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C sec010.log-debug-not-safe OL SEC-010 MUST_NOT ;; Trace/Debug are never a safe place for sensitive data. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api009.log-expected-not-errors OL API-009 DEFAULT ;; Expected business outcomes such as NotFound or validation rejection are normally not errors. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api012.log-at-boundary OL API-012 MUST ;; Log at the boundary that handles or terminates the failure; no extra log when rethrowing without handling. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.log-correlation EX RUN-013 PREFER ;; Prefer platform trace identifiers; explicit correlation ids only for a concrete need; propagate tracing context across outbound calls. ;; = ;; none ;; EXC-013 context.
C sec003.log-validate-correlation OL SEC-003 MUST ;; Validate or normalize correlation ids accepted from clients. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run014.log-specific-props OL RUN-014,SEC-010 MUST ;; Log specific properties instead of serialized objects/bodies; avoid authorization headers and sensitive full bodies; prefer stable technical identifiers over personal data. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run008.log-source-gen OL RUN-008 DEFAULT ;; Normal structured logging suffices; source-generated logging for measured high-volume hot paths. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run013.log-anti-list OL RUN-013,API-012,API-009,SEC-010,RUN-014,DEP-021 AVOID ;; Avoid interpolated messages, duplicate exception logging, expected outcomes as errors, secrets in logs, whole-object dumps without review and provider-specific APIs in use-case code. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.log-no-audit-db EX RUN-013 AVOID ;; Do not use logs as an audit database without an adopted audit design. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.

C run009.mc-when-clearer OL RUN-009 DEFAULT ;; Use a feature when it makes code clearer, safer or simpler, never to demonstrate newer syntax; consistency and readability beat maximal feature use. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.mc-constructors EX RUN-009 PREFER ;; Use a regular constructor when validation/initialization is non-trivial, explicit fields read better, the codebase uses that style or capture would obscure the class. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C run009.mc-no-mechanical-ctor OL RUN-009 MUST_NOT ;; Never convert constructors mechanically. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.mc-records EX RUN-009 DEFAULT ;; Records for intentional value semantics (immutable DTOs, value objects, messages); identity/lifecycle entities stay classes unless record semantics genuinely help. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C run008.mc-no-record-struct OL RUN-008 AVOID ;; Avoid record struct merely to dodge allocations. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.mc-feature-usage EX RUN-009 DEFAULT ;; required for valid-construction contracts (not invariant validation); collection expressions when the target type is clear; patterns/switch when they clarify, no deep nesting; field keyword to remove trivial backing fields. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C run009.mc-no-rewrite-initializers OL RUN-009 MUST_NOT ;; Do not rewrite existing initializers just to modernize. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run009.mc-extensions-valid OL RUN-009 MUST_NOT ;; Extension members when they improve an API; ordinary extension methods remain valid (no mechanical conversion). ;; = ;; none ;;
C run008.mc-raw-strings OL RUN-008,SEC-004 MUST_NOT ;; Raw string literals are never an excuse for raw SQL. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.mc-var EX RUN-009 DEFAULT ;; var when the type is obvious or unimportant; explicit types when they aid understanding; follow the project convention. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C x.mc-visibility-sealed EX RUN-009 DEFAULT ;; Keep implementation details non-public; sealed to communicate non-inheritance, not as a speculative JIT optimization. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C x.mc-naming EX RUN-024 DEFAULT ;; PascalCase types/methods/properties/public members, camelCase parameters/locals, meaningful names, private-field naming per convention. ;; = ;; none ;; Beyond RUN-024.
C x.mc-nested-types EX RUN-024 ALLOWED ;; Small private or nested supporting types may stay with their owner for locality. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C run011.mc-no-reorder OL RUN-011 MUST_NOT ;; Do not reorganize a file only to satisfy a preferred member order. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.mc-immutability EX RUN-009 PREFER ;; Prefer immutability when it models the domain naturally, not where controlled mutation is simpler. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C run008.mc-spans OL RUN-008,RUN-001 DEFAULT ;; Span/stackalloc/pooling/preallocated buffers/source-generated serialization only for demonstrated allocation-heavy hot paths, verified; ordinary collections by default. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.mc-langversion-check EX RUN-009 MUST ;; Confirm the configured language version supports a feature. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C x.mc-langversion-approval EX DEP-008,ARC-020 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Changing LangVersion or the target framework requires approval. ;; = ;; none ;; DEP-008 gates only preview/RC moves.
C run009.mc-modernization-task OL RUN-009,GOV-014,WF-005 MUST ;; When asked to modernize preserve behaviour, keep it focused, favour readability, build and test, no architecture refactoring mixed in. ;; = ;; none ;;
